### ✨ Aether Gazer Mod Menu (v1.0.2)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Completely negates all incoming damage for player & allies
- **Heal on Hit** — Converts incoming damage into instant HP recovery
- **Super Armor (Unflinching)** — Prevents stagger, knockback, and hit interruptions (mIsStoic)
- **One-Hit Kill (OHK)** — Instantly defeats enemies with -999,999,999 damage
- **Enable Damage Multiplier** — Scales outgoing damage against enemies by selected factor
- **Damage Multiplier** — Multiplier factor applied to enemy hits
- **Infinite Dodge / Zero Avoid CD** — Removes ultimate avoid cooldown for continuous dodging
- **Infinite Skill Energy / Power** — Keeps skill energy / rage / divine power at maximum
- **No Skill Cooldown** — Instantly resets ability cooldowns to 0
- **Game Speed Multiplier** — Accelerates Unity Time.timeScale (1.0x to 5.0x)
- **Unlock 120 FPS** — Forces target framerate to 120 FPS
- **Reset All Settings** — Reverts all modifications and restores default values
- **Telegram: @m0hmm3d** — Tap to contact or join on Telegram

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
